result.stdout:
BifrostQL CLI Tool

Usage: bifrost <command> [options]
       bifrost <server> <database> [options]
       bifrost <config-file> [options]

Commands:
  config-generate      Generate config rules from database schema patterns
  config-validate      Validate config rules against the database schema
  doctor               Diagnose configuration and connection issues
  export               Export database schema to JSON, SQL, or Markdown
  init                 Create a default bifrostql.json config file
  schema               Print the GraphQL schema (SDL) for the database
  serve                Start a standalone BifrostQL GraphQL server
  test                 Test database connection and report schema summary
  watch                Watch for database schema changes and reload

Options:
  --connection-string  Database connection string
  --config             Path to bifrostql.json config file
  --user               Database username (prompts for password securely)
  --json               Output in JSON format for scripting
  --port               Port for serve command (default: 5000)
  --trust-server-certificate
                       Accept the SQL Server TLS certificate without validating it.
                       Encrypted but the server's identity is unverified, so anyone
                       on the network path can intercept it. Use only for a server
                       whose self-signed certificate you already trust.

Examples:
  bifrost myserver mydb                   Quick start with integrated auth
  bifrost myserver mydb --user sa         Prompt for password securely
  bifrost myserver mydb --port 3000       Custom port
  bifrost bifrostql.json                  Use config file
  bifrost serve                           Auto-discover bifrostql.json
  bifrost serve --connection-string "..." Explicit connection string

Developer Commands:
  bifrost doctor                          Diagnose connection issues
  bifrost watch                           Watch for schema changes
  bifrost export [format]        
[truncated]
